scope: L2 mapping replacement, not stock FlyDrones flight or biological-response ranking
revision_note: Stimuli, metrics and detection thresholds fixed before first comparison. Initial run stopped without publishing results: the 30-frame moving-phase minimum was also applied to the 0.4-second baseline (~24 frames). Revision 1.1 requires 10 baseline frames separately. After inspecting 1.1, revision 1.2 adds paired statistics on the intersection of detected IDs, so unequal detection coverage cannot give misleading error comparisons. No response thresholds changed; this engineering protocol is not preregistered research.
reference_order: ascending numerical body ID, all 1779 published-inventory L2 cells
baseline: Unmodified pinned upstream Retina and InputEncoder, explicitly configured for the SAME L2 groups and positive brightness gain; upstream defaults normally drive other cell types
oracle: Independent azimuth/elevation pinhole formula, using the same published angular data and assumed mounting; NOT an independent biological ground truth
footprints: Upstream resized/blurred 6x8 area grids per image half versus bridge bilinear center-ray samples; grayscale avoids RGB-weight differences

recorded.scope: Optional retrospective replay of already collected calibrated_temporal_v1; no new acquisition or prospective biological validation
recorded.selection: All L2 IDs from the pre-existing frozen photometric LUT, selected before this adapter comparison
recorded.metric: Pairwise passage-time difference error against fiducial-registered published positions; no fitted time offset or amplitude gain per encoder
recorded.screen_qualification: Uses existing independently generated display bars and optical phase labels; expected cell locations still depend on published correspondence
recorded.missing: Non-detections included in coverage denominator; pairwise metrics use detected pairs and report their count; no filling missing traces
